info.title: Kontor CRM API (WooCommerce integration)
info.description:
OpenAPI description of the Kontor CRM API used by the WooCommerce integration, reverse-engineered by exercising the LIVE API and recording real request/response behavior.

## Authentication
Every request requires the header `x-api-key: <YOUR_API_KEY>`. Send `Content-Type: application/json` (not strictly enforced, but recommended).

> SECURITY: the working API key was exposed in email/chat; rotate it and store the new key in a secret manager — never in source, docs, screenshots, or logs.

## Behavioral notes (verified against the live API)
- `entity`/`name` are the operation selectors; `entity` is case-insensitive.
- `products` paging: default & hard-cap `take` = 2000; `take:0` yields `success:false`,`data:null`; `skip` past the end returns empty data.
- `filter.herstellerids` is OR-combined, matched EXACTLY (no trimming, no leading-zero normalization).
- `filter.shoptype` (`B2B`/`B2C`/`EDU`, default `B2B`) is not validated (unknown values are echoed); all variants currently share identical text.
- `stock`/`manufacturer`/`shops` ignore `paging` and `filter`. `Lagerbestand` is decimal on `stock`, integer on `products`.
- `orders` search honours ONLY `filter.shopid` (other keys ignored); malformed UUID => 500. Result set appears capped around 1000 rows.
- Upsert `success` stays `true` on business failures; check each row's `status`. Duplicate `orderNumber` (overwrite_all:false) => `fehler` / `Dublette`.
- Error shapes: standard envelope (`ERR-400`/`ERR-500`), short 401 auth envelope, and ASP.NET `problem+json` for malformed JSON; `GET`/empty body => 405.

tags.name: search
tags.description: Read operations (products, stock, manufacturers, shops, orders).

post.summary: Read products, stock, manufacturers, shops, or orders
post.description: Polymorphic read endpoint. The operation is selected by `entity` (case-insensitive). Only `products` honours `paging`; only `products`/`orders` honour `filter`; `stock`/`manufacturer`/`shops` ignore both and return the full list.

200.description: Search succeeded. `data` item shape depends on `entity`.

3 Jahre.

post.description: The only write endpoint. Selected by `name` (`orders`). IMPORTANT: the top-level `success` is `true` even when individual orders fail — inspect each result row's `status` (`ok`/`fehler`). Duplicates (same `orderNumber`, `overwrite_all:false`) are rejected, not updated. Confirm you are targeting the intended (test vs. production) environment before use.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key issued by Kontor/3AG. Placeholder: `<YOUR_API_KEY>`.

Meta.description: Timing/paging metadata attached to most successful responses.

rowCount.description: Number of rows returned in `data` for this response.

totalCount.description: Total rows matching the query ignoring paging. For `products` this reflects the active filter. `null` on write/error responses.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Standard error envelope returned for validation (`ERR-400`) and execution (`ERR-500`) failures on the search/upsert operations.

errorCode.description: One of: `ERR-400` (invalid parameters), `ERR-500` (execution failed). Auth failures use a different envelope (see `AuthErrorEnvelope`).

details.description: Human-readable German/English detail, e.g. `entity is required`, `Unknown entity: X`, `Fehler beim Konvertieren einer Zeichenfolge in "uniqueidentifier".`

AuthErrorEnvelope.description: Short envelope used ONLY for 401 authentication failures. Note it omits `meta`, `data` and `details`.

ProblemDetails.description: ASP.NET Core `application/problem+json` body returned by the framework (NOT the API envelope) when the request body is not valid JSON. HTTP 500.

title.example: An error occurred while processing your request.

detail.example: Invalid character after parsing property name. Expected ':' but got: j. Path '', line 1, position 5.

Paging.description: Paging control. Honoured ONLY by the `products` entity; ignored by `stock`, `manufacturer`, `shops`, `orders`.

skip.description: Rows to skip. Negative values are treated as 0. `skip` beyond `totalCount` returns an empty `data` array with `success:true`.

take.description: Page size. Omitted => 2000. HARD-CAPPED at 2000 (values >2000 and -1 all return 2000). `take:0` is rejected: the response is `success:false`, `data:null`.

herstellerids.description: Comma-separated manufacturer IDs; multiple IDs are OR-combined (e.g. `"11,5"` returns products of manufacturer 11 OR 5). WARNING: values are matched EXACTLY as stored — there is NO whitespace trimming (`"11, 5"` matches only `11`) and NO leading-zero normalization (`"5"` matches but `"05"`/`"005"` match nothing). Note manufacturer IDs are inconsistent in the data: some are zero-padded (`075`, `104`) and some are short (`5`, `11`, `18`). Use the exact `Herstellerid` from the manufacturer list.

shoptype.description: Selects the shop-specific text variant (`Shoptitel`/`Kurztext`/`Langtext`). Defaults to `B2B` when omitted. NOT validated: an unknown value is echoed back in the `Shoptype` field and rows are still returned. At time of testing all three variants returned identical text (per-shop content not yet maintained in Kontor).

StockSearchRequest.description: Returns the full stock list. `paging` and `filter` are accepted but IGNORED — the entire list is always returned.

ManufacturerSearchRequest.description: Returns the full manufacturer list. `paging`/`filter` are ignored.

ShopsSearchRequest.description: Returns the full shop list. `paging`/`filter` are ignored.

shopid.description: Kontor shop UUID (case-insensitive). Only this filter key is honoured — any other keys (e.g. `ordernumber`, `orderstatus`) are silently IGNORED. A missing/empty/unknown-but-well-formed UUID returns `success:true` with an empty `data` array; a MALFORMED (non-UUID) value returns HTTP 500 (`ERR-500`, uniqueidentifier conversion error).

Product.description: Product master-data row. Note: the `Categories` field is present in live responses but was absent from the original draft doc.

Herstellerid.description: Manufacturer ID. May be null. Not zero-normalized (`11`, `075`, ...).

Mpn.description: Manufacturer part number. May be null.

Shoptype.description: Text variant echoed for the requested `shoptype` (not validated).

Kurztext.description:
Shop-specific short description. May contain HTML (`

`, `
`, `\r\n`). May be null.

Langtext.description: Shop-specific long description. May contain HTML. May be null.

Lagerbestand.description: Stock quantity. Returned as an INTEGER on products (contrast: decimal on the `stock` entity).

MainImageURL.description: Main image FILENAME only (prefix with the configured image base, e.g. `https://daten.3ag.ch/images/`). May be null.

Categories.description: Comma-separated category IDs (mixed lowercase-hash and uppercase-GUID forms). Empty string when uncategorized.

Lagerbestand.description: Stock quantity. DECIMAL on this entity (e.g. `111.000`).

Herstellerid.description: Manufacturer ID (string; leading zeros preserved). Use in `filter.herstellerids`.

Shopid.description: Kontor shop UUID. Use as `shopid` for order search/upsert.

provider.description: Shipping provider. Observed values: `planzer`, `Andere` ("Other"). May be null.

trackingurl.description: Tracking URL. May be an empty string or a provider URL.

userId.description: Arbitrary user identifier. REQUIRED (missing => `ERR-400` `meta.userId is required`).

Address.description: Postal address. All fields optional; supply what invoicing/delivery needs.

priceFaktor.description: Price factor. Keep API spelling exactly (`priceFaktor`).

Order.description: A single order. Most fields are optional (per Kontor: the practical requirements are customer/invoicing data, a delivery address if it differs from billing, and line items with sku/quantity/price/tax). `orderNumber` is the deduplication key.

orderId.description: WooCommerce internal order ID or display order number (display number recommended).

orderPlatformid.description: Platform identifier string (identifies the platform, e.g. `Toysonline`).

orderAccountid.description: Subaccount ID relative to the platform. Not relevant here; may be null.

orderNumber.description: Unique shop order number. DEDUPLICATION KEY: Kontor checks this to decide create-vs-skip.

shopid.description: Target Kontor shop UUID (case-insensitive). Malformed value => HTTP 500.

overwrite_all.description: When false, existing orders (matched by `orderNumber`) are NOT overwritten — a duplicate is reported per-order as `status:"fehler"` / `"Auftrag bereits vorhanden (Dublette)."`.

orders.description: Orders to import. An empty array or a missing `orders` key returns `success:true` with a single `fehler` result row (`JSON-Array enthält keine Aufträge.` / `@OrdersJson ist leer.`).

name.description: Upsert operation name. REQUIRED (missing => `ERR-400`). An unknown name => HTTP 500 (`Upsert-Parameter Name ungültig`).

UpsertResultRow.description: Per-order result. NOTE: business failures do NOT change the top-level `success` (which stays true); inspect `status`.

auftrnr.description: Kontor internal order number on success; null on failure.

message.description: Null on success. On failure, e.g. `Auftrag bereits vorhanden (Dublette).`, `JSON-Array enthält keine Aufträge.`, `@OrdersJson ist leer.`

SearchResponse.description: Successful search envelope. `data` item shape depends on the requested `entity` (see the named examples).

BadRequest400.description: Validation failure (`ERR-400`) — e.g. missing `entity`/`name`/`meta.userId`, or empty request body.

Unauthorized401.description: Missing or invalid `x-api-key`. Uses the short auth envelope.

ServerError500.description: Execution failure (`ERR-500`) — e.g. unknown entity/name or malformed UUID. Malformed JSON bodies instead return an ASP.NET `problem+json` (see schema `ProblemDetails`).

value.details: Fehler beim Konvertieren einer Zeichenfolge in "uniqueidentifier".

MethodNotAllowed405.description: Returned (empty body) for `GET`/`HEAD` or a request with no body. Use `POST` with a JSON body.
